### Module 05 — Clinical Text Preprocessing

# Clinical Text Preprocessing

***
**Learning objectives**
- Understand unique challenges of clinical NLP vs general-domain NLP
- Tokenise, sentence-split, and normalise clinical text
- Detect and de-identify PHI using rule-based regex
- Expand clinical abbreviations
- Extract section headers, vital signs and lab values
- Build a reusable end-to-end preprocessing pipeline

**Estimated time:** 2 hours | **Level:** Intermediate | **Libraries:** `stringr`, `tidytext`, `quanteda`, `dplyr`

## 1. Setup & Synthetic Clinical Notes

```{r setup, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
library(tidyverse)
library(stringr)
library(tidytext)
library(quanteda)

set.seed(42)
mod05_dir <- file.path(tempdir(), "mod05")
dir.create(mod05_dir, showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)

theme_set(
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
    theme(
      panel.background = element_rect(fill = "white", colour = NA),
      plot.background  = element_rect(fill = "white", colour = NA),

      axis.ticks       = element_line(colour = "grey40")
```

## 2. Clinical Challenges Overview

| Challenge | Example | Impact |
|---|---|---|
| **Abbreviations** | SOB, HTN, DM2, BID | Out-of-vocabulary words |
| **Negation** | "denies fever", "no CP" | False positive extraction |
| **Measurements** | BP 142/88, SpO2 94% | Require special regex |
| **Sections** | HPI, A&P, LABS | Document-level semantics |
| **PHI** | Names, MRN, DOB | HIPAA de-identification |

## 3. Clinical Abbreviation Expansion

```{r}
clinical_abbrevs <- c(
  DM2  = "type 2 diabetes mellitus",
  HTN  = "hypertension",
  CKD  = "chronic kidney disease",
  HF   = "heart failure",
  CAD  = "coronary artery disease",
  COPD = "chronic obstructive pulmonary disease",
  PE   = "pulmonary embolism",
  SOB  = "shortness of breath",
  CP   = "chest pain",
  LE   = "lower extremity",
  `c/o` = "complaining of",
  `h/o` = "history of",
  PMH  = "past medical history",
  `s/p` = "status post",
  Pt   = "patient",
  pt   = "patient",
  HR   = "heart rate",
  BP   = "blood pressure",
  RR   = "respiratory rate",
  SpO2 = "oxygen saturation",
  EF   = "ejection fraction",
  BNP  = "brain natriuretic peptide",
  A1c  = "hemoglobin A1c",
  PO   = "by mouth",
  IV   = "intravenous",
  BID  = "twice daily",
  QD   = "once daily",
  QAM  = "every morning",
  q4h  = "every 4 hours",
  q8h  = "every 8 hours",
  EKG  = "electrocardiogram",
  CXR  = "chest X-ray",
  ABG  = "arterial blood gas",
  ECHO = "echocardiogram",
  NTG  = "nitroglycerin",
  ASA  = "aspirin",
  Cr   = "creatinine",
  BUN  = "blood urea nitrogen",
  NC   = "nasal cannula"
)

expand_abbreviations <- function(text, abbrev_dict = clinical_abbrevs) {
  # Longest abbreviations first so "DM2" is not split by "DM"
  ord <- order(nchar(names(abbrev_dict)), decreasing = TRUE)
  for (i in ord) {
    abbrev <- names(abbrev_dict)[i]
    expansion <- unname(abbrev_dict[i])
    pattern <- paste0("\\b", stringr::str_replace_all(abbrev, "([\\W])", "\\\\\\1"), "\\b")
    text <- stringr::str_replace_all(text, stringr::regex(pattern), expansion)
  }
  text
}

sample <- "Pt c/o SOB and LE edema. HTN and DM2 noted. HR 98, BP 142/88, SpO2 94% on RA."
cat("Original:", sample, "\n")
cat("Expanded:", expand_abbreviations(sample), "\n")
```

## 4. PHI Detection & De-identification

```{r}
phi_patterns <- c(
  PATIENT_NAME  = "(?:Patient|Pt)\\s*:\\s*[A-Z][a-z]+\\s+[A-Z][a-z]+",
  PROVIDER_NAME = "(?:Dr\\.|Attending)\\s*:\\s*[A-Z][a-z]+\\s+[A-Z][a-z]+",
  MRN           = "MRN\\s*:\\s*\\d{6,10}",
  DATE_OF_BIRTH = "DOB\\s*:\\s*\\d{1,2}/\\d{1,2}/\\d{4}",
  DATE          = "\\b\\d{1,2}/\\d{1,2}/\\d{4}\\b",
  AGE           = "\\b\\d{2,3}\\s*(?:y/o|year[-\\s]old|yo)\\b"
)

detect_phi <- function(text) {
  found <- purrr::imap_dfr(phi_patterns, function(pattern, phi_type) {
    m <- gregexpr(pattern, text, perl = TRUE, ignore.case = TRUE)[[1]]
    if (m[1] == -1) {
      return(tibble::tibble(type = character(), text = character(),
                            start = integer(), end = integer()))
    }
    matched <- regmatches(text, list(m))[[1]]
    tibble::tibble(
      type  = phi_type,
      text  = matched,
      start = as.integer(m),
      end   = as.integer(m + attr(m, "match.length"))
    )
  })
  dplyr::arrange(found, start)
}

deidentify <- function(text) {
  result <- text
  spans <- purrr::imap_dfr(phi_patterns, function(pattern, phi_type) {
    m <- gregexpr(pattern, result, perl = TRUE, ignore.case = TRUE)[[1]]
    if (m[1] == -1) {
      return(tibble::tibble(start = integer(), end = integer(),
                            replacement = character()))
    }
    tibble::tibble(
      start       = as.integer(m),
      end         = as.integer(m + attr(m, "match.length")),
      replacement = paste0("[", phi_type, "]")
    )
  })
  if (nrow(spans) == 0) return(result)
  spans <- dplyr::arrange(spans, dplyr::desc(start))
  for (i in seq_len(nrow(spans))) {
    result <- paste0(
      substr(result, 1, spans$start[i] - 1),
      spans$replacement[i],
      substr(result, spans$end[i], nchar(result))
    )
  }
  result
}

note1 <- df_notes$text[1]
phi_found <- detect_phi(note1)
cat(sprintf("PHI detected (%d instances):\n", nrow(phi_found)))
purrr::pwalk(phi_found, function(type, text, ...) {
  cat(sprintf("  [%-15s] '%s'\n", type, text))
})
cat("\n--- De-identified (first 300 chars) ---\n")
cat(substr(deidentify(note1), 1, 300), "\n")
```

## 5. Section Extraction

```{r}
section_patterns <- c(
  HPI         = "(?:HISTORY OF PRESENT ILLNESS|HPI)\\s*:?",
  MEDICATIONS = "MEDICATIONS?\\s*:?",
  ASSESSMENT  = "(?:ASSESSMENT(?:\\s+AND\\s+PLAN)?|A/?P|IMPRESSION)\\s*:?",
  LABS        = "LABS?\\s*:?",
  PLAN        = "PLAN\\s*:?",
  DISCHARGE   = "DISCHARGE CONDITION\\s*:?"
)

extract_sections <- function(text) {
  headers <- purrr::imap_dfr(section_patterns, function(pattern, name) {
    m <- gregexpr(pattern, text, perl = TRUE, ignore.case = TRUE)[[1]]
    if (m[1] == -1) {
      return(tibble::tibble(start = integer(), end = integer(), name = character()))
    }
    tibble::tibble(
      start = as.integer(m),
      end   = as.integer(m + attr(m, "match.length")),
      name  = name
    )
  })
  if (nrow(headers) == 0) return(list())
  headers <- dplyr::arrange(headers, start)
  sections <- list()
  for (i in seq_len(nrow(headers))) {
    next_start <- if (i < nrow(headers)) headers$start[i + 1] else nchar(text) + 1
    content <- substr(text, headers$end[i], next_start - 1)
    content <- stringr::str_squish(stringr::str_replace_all(content, "\\n+", " "))
    if (nzchar(content)) sections[[headers$name[i]]] <- content
  }
  sections
}

cat("Sections extracted per note:\n\n")
purrr::pwalk(df_notes, function(note_id, note_type, text, ...) {
  secs <- extract_sections(text)
  cat(sprintf("%s (%s):\n", note_id, note_type))
  purrr::iwalk(secs, function(content, sec) {
    preview <- if (nchar(content) > 70) paste0(substr(content, 1, 70), "...") else content
    cat(sprintf("  [%-12s] %s\n", sec, preview))
  })
  cat("\n")
})
```

## 6. Vital Signs & Lab Value Extraction

```{r}
vital_patterns <- c(
  temperature    = "T\\s*(?:emp)?\\s*:?\\s*(\\d{2,3}\\.?\\d?)\\s*[CF]?",
  heart_rate     = "HR\\s*:?\\s*(\\d{2,3})\\s*(?:bpm)?",
  blood_pressure = "BP\\s*:?\\s*(\\d{2,3})\\s*/\\s*(\\d{2,3})",
  resp_rate      = "RR\\s*:?\\s*(\\d{1,2})",
  spo2           = "SpO2\\s*:?\\s*(\\d{2,3})\\s*%"
)
lab_patterns <- c(
  sodium        = "Na\\s*(\\d{3})",
  potassium     = "K\\s*(\\d\\.\\d)",
  creatinine    = "Cr\\s*(\\d\\.\\d)",
  bnp           = "BNP\\s*(\\d{2,5})",
  troponin_i    = "Troponin\\s*I\\s*:?\\s*(\\d+\\.\\d+)",
  ejection_frac = "EF\\s*(\\d{2})\\s*%"
)

extract_vitals_labs <- function(text) {
  results <- list()
  all_pats <- c(vital_patterns, lab_patterns)
  for (name in names(all_pats)) {
    m <- stringr::str_match(text, stringr::regex(all_pats[[name]], ignore_case = TRUE))
    if (!is.na(m[1, 1])) {
      if (name == "blood_pressure") {
        results$systolic  <- as.numeric(m[1, 2])
        results$diastolic <- as.numeric(m[1, 3])
      } else {
        val <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(m[1, 2]))
        results[[name]] <- if (!is.na(val)) val else m[1, 2]
      }
    }
  }
  results
}

cat("Extracted vitals & labs:\n\n")
purrr::pwalk(df_notes, function(note_id, text, ...) {
  extracted <- extract_vitals_labs(text)
  cat(sprintf("  %s: ", note_id))
  print(extracted)
})
```

## 7. Negation Detection

```{r}
negation_triggers <- c(
  "\\bno\\b", "\\bnot\\b", "\\bdenies?\\b", "\\bwithout\\b",
  "\\bw/o\\b", "\\bnever\\b", "\\babsent\\b", "\\bnegative\\b"
)

is_negated <- function(text, entity, window = 5) {
  tokens <- stringr::str_split(tolower(text), "\\s+")[[1]]
  entity_lower <- tolower(entity)
  for (i in seq_along(tokens)) {
    if (stringr::str_detect(tokens[i], stringr::fixed(entity_lower))) {
      lo <- max(1, i - window)
      context <- paste(tokens[lo:max(1, i - 1)], collapse = " ")
      if (i == 1) context <- ""
      for (trigger in negation_triggers) {
        if (stringr::str_detect(context, stringr::regex(trigger, ignore_case = TRUE))) {
          return(TRUE)
        }
      }
    }
  }
  FALSE
}

test_cases <- tibble::tibble(
  sentence = c(
    "Pt denies chest pain or fever.",
    "Patient has no fever or chills.",
    "Bilateral wheezes are present.",
    "No consolidation identified.",
    "Chest pain 8/10, radiating to left arm.",
    "Hypoxia present on admission."
  ),
  entity = c("chest pain", "fever", "wheezes", "consolidation", "chest pain", "hypoxia")
)

cat(sprintf("%-55s %-15s %s\n", "Sentence", "Entity", "Negated"))
cat(strrep("-", 85), "\n")
purrr::pwalk(test_cases, function(sentence, entity) {
  neg <- is_negated(sentence, entity)
  status <- if (neg) "NEGATED" else "Affirmed"
  cat(sprintf("  %-52s %-15s %s\n", substr(sentence, 1, 52), entity, status))
})
```

## 8. Full Preprocessing Pipeline

```{r}
preprocess_clinical_note <- function(text, note_id = "") {
  result <- list(note_id = note_id, original_length = nchar(text))
  result$phi_detected  <- detect_phi(text)
  clean <- deidentify(text)
  result$expanded_text <- expand_abbreviations(clean)
  result$sections      <- extract_sections(text)
  result$vitals_labs   <- extract_vitals_labs(text)
  lines <- stringr::str_split(result$expanded_text, "\n")[[1]]
  sentences <- lines[nchar(stringr::str_squish(lines)) > 0]
  sentences <- sentences[purrr::map_int(stringr::str_split(sentences, "\\s+"), length) > 5]
  result$sentences      <- sentences
  result$sentence_count <- length(sentences)
  result
}

cat("Running preprocessing pipeline...\n\n")
purrr::pwalk(df_notes, function(note_id, text, ...) {
  proc <- preprocess_clinical_note(text, note_id = note_id)
  cat(sprintf("%s: %d sentences | %d PHI | %d sections | %d values\n",
              note_id, proc$sentence_count,
              nrow(proc$phi_detected),
              length(proc$sections),
              length(proc$vitals_labs)))
})
```

## 9. Medication Extraction Exercise

```{r}
med_pattern <- paste0(
  "(\\d+\\.\\s+)?([A-Z][a-zA-Z]+(?:\\s+[a-zA-Z]+)?)",
  "\\s+(\\d+(?:\\.\\d+)?\\s*(?:mg|mcg|g|mL|units?))",
  "(?:\\s+((?:PO|IV|SQ|IM)\\s+(?:BID|QD|TID|QAM|q\\d+h)))?"
)

extract_medications <- function(text) {
  m <- stringr::str_match_all(text, stringr::regex(med_pattern, ignore_case = TRUE))[[1]]
  if (nrow(m) == 0) {
    return(tibble::tibble(drug = character(), dose = character(), route_freq = character()))
  }
  tibble::tibble(
    drug       = stringr::str_squish(m[, 3]),
    dose       = stringr::str_squish(m[, 4]),
    route_freq = stringr::str_squish(ifelse(is.na(m[, 5]), "", m[, 5]))
  )
}

purrr::pwalk(df_notes, function(note_id, text, ...) {
  meds <- extract_medications(text)
  if (nrow(meds) > 0) {
    cat(sprintf("%s:\n", note_id))
    purrr::pwalk(meds, function(drug, dose, route_freq) {
      cat(sprintf("  %-20s %-12s %s\n", drug, dose, route_freq))
    })
  }
})
```

Quanteda tokenisation of the de-identified notes (clinical stop words removed):

```{r}
deid_notes <- purrr::map_chr(df_notes$text, deidentify)
corp <- quanteda::corpus(deid_notes, docnames = df_notes$note_id)
toks <- quanteda::tokens(corp, remove_punct = TRUE, remove_numbers = FALSE) |>
  quanteda::tokens_tolower() |>
  quanteda::tokens_remove(quanteda::stopwords("en"))
print(toks)
print(quanteda::dfm(toks))
```
